rubrics.criterion: Clicking unclaimed land claims territory and clicking opponent territory launches attacks with multiple simultaneous attacks active and no page reload
Map viewport pans via drag or W/A/S/D and zooms via wheel or pinch from fitted minimum to 8x with camera clamping so no empty area beyond the map appears
Bottom control bar shows live status IDLE / TAKING WILDERNESS / ATTACKING {name}, troop bar with red→green→gold gradient, gold pill with +/min income, and territory percentage with thin 80% tick

City and Fort build buttons display dynamic gold cost, enter placement mode on click or hotkeys 1/2 showing PLACING CITY/FORT banner, and place only on owned territory deducting gold with Esc to cancel

Entry shows Meta RTS title with Enter your name field and Play/Tutorial actions; clicking Play triggers ~3s cloud drift outward with camera ease to starting location prompt and reaching 80% ownership shows Victory! dialog with spring scale-in and Play Again
